data: Which side of the pie chart does the section for AskReddit colored in blue lie?

The question asks about the position of the AskReddit section colored in blue on the pie chart. From the analysis, we know that the pie chart is divided into two sections: one for males and one for females. The AskReddit section is colored in blue and is located in the male section. Therefore, the AskReddit section colored in blue lies on the left side of the pie chart.
